# Android SDK license

The published Google Maven POM for `com.android.billingclient:billing:9.1.0` identifies the
Android Software Development Kit License (`ASDKL`). AboutLibraries identifies it but supplies no full text.
`LICENSE` is the complete agreement dated April 28, 2026, retrieved on October 22, 2026 from
[the POM-linked Android terms page](https://developer.android.com/studio/terms.html).
The generated catalog uses this text for dependencies whose metadata identifies `ASDKL`; it retains their
original license identifier and any notices embedded in their archives.
